name: Projective Spatial Transformer (ProST)
definition: A differentiable volume rendering module that generalizes spatial transformers to projective geometry, enabling volumetric rendering of transmission images differentiable with respect to input volume and pose parameters.
summary: ProST is a differentiable volume rendering module that projects voxelized data onto 2D planes using cone-beam ray casting, enabling end-to-end gradient flow for 2D/3D registration.
